text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sun is scorching and senior year
summer camp
has arrived! And as for
Mejiro Ardan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
During this summer camp, I wish to go
1000 times
beyond my limit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That said, I am serious about pushing my
limits.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This will be a great opportunity to
thoroughly
prepare for the Mainichi
Okan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: Let's go into this fired up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Another hot and heated summer camp is
about to
begin!
